column_description: A SERIAL primary key for treatment outcome records (e.g., 201).
An enum (therapyprogress_enum) describing therapy progress (Fair, Good, Poor).
An enum (treatmentadherence_enum) referencing overall treatment adherence (Non-compliant, Medium, Low, High).
An enum (treatmentresponse_enum) for treatment response (Poor, Good, Partial).
An enum (sideeffectburden_enum) describing side effect burden (Mild, Moderate, Severe).
An enum (treatmentgoalsstatus_enum) for treatment goals status (Not Started, Achieved, In Progress, Modified).
An enum (recoverygoalsstatus_enum) for recovery goals status (Not Started, Achieved, In Progress, Modified).
An enum (symptomimprovement_enum) indicating symptom improvement (Moderate, Minimal, Significant).
An enum (functionalimprovement_enum) capturing functional improvement (Moderate, Minimal, Significant).
An enum (workstatuschanges_enum) referencing changes in work status (Leave, Reduced Hours, Terminated).
An enum (therapeuticalliance_enum) describing alliance (Moderate, Poor, Strong, Weak).
An enum (treatmentengagement_enum) describing overall engagement (Non-compliant, High, Medium, Low).
An enum (treatmentsatisfaction_enum) describing treatment satisfaction (Medium, Dissatisfied, Low, High).
